idea-plugin.name: Learnosity Build Aide MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Build Learnosity integrations directly from your AI coding assistant.

Install the plugin and AI Assistant or Junie can answer from Learnosity's own documentation, API references and guided integration Skills. There is no account to create, no API key to paste and no configuration file to edit.

Features

  • Source-backed answers from the Learnosity Help Site, Author Guide, Feedback Aide docs, Demos and public GitHub repositories, with citations.
  • Integration Skills for the golden path (Author, Items, Reports), request signing, LTS upgrades, content migration and more.
  • Read-only and authless. The server never asks for, receives or stores your consumer key or secret.

Get started

  1. Install the plugin (a 2025.3 or later IDE with AI Assistant or Junie). It adds the learnosity-build-aide server to each of them:
    • AI Assistant: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP). AI Assistant asks before it runs a new server, so enable it there; the plugin's notification opens that page for you.
    • Junie: Settings | Tools | Junie | MCP Settings, ready to use. This also covers the Junie CLI.
  2. Open AI Chat or Junie and ask, for example: "Using the Learnosity Build Aide MCP, how do I sign an Items API request in Node.js?"

Tools

  • search_docs_sources: Search the indexed Learnosity documentation
  • read_document: Read a document in full
  • list_docs_sources / list_docs_categories: Discover sources and categories
  • skills_list / skills_search / skills_read: Find and read integration Skills
  • get_feedback_link: Get the link to share feedback

Learn more

Setup for other clients, security and data handling, rate limits, troubleshooting and FAQs are in the Learnosity Build MCPs documentation. Tell us what to improve on the feedback page. To report a security issue, open a support ticket and mark it as a security issue.

Important Information about the Learnosity Build Aide MCP

Availability: The Learnosity Build Aide MCP is provided on an 'as available' basis. It is not subject to any availability, uptime, support, response or resolution commitments applicable to Learnosity Software or Services under a customer agreement.

Third-party agent output: The Learnosity Build Aide MCP makes Learnosity's published documentation and integration guidance available through the Model Context Protocol. The MCP may be used by third-party AI agents, coding assistants and other developer tools. Learnosity is not responsible for, and does not warrant the accuracy, completeness or suitability of, any code, configuration, recommendations or other output generated by those third-party tools using information obtained through the MCP. Any such output should be appropriately reviewed and tested before use, particularly in a production environment.

Changes/rate limits: Learnosity may apply reasonable rate limits and may modify, suspend or discontinue the Learnosity Build Aide MCP from time to time.

Personal data: Users should not submit personal data or other sensitive information through third-party tools when using the MCP unless they are satisfied that the relevant third-party tool is appropriate for that information.

Also published in the Learnosity Build Aide MCP Terms of Service.
